name: The Four of Us
overview: The Four of Us is a South African telenovela which is a family drama centred on the influential Dhlomo family in which old wounds, power struggles and long-held resentments threaten to tear the family apart. After their father's death, siblings Bobbi and Busani Dhlomo battle for wealth, power and control of their family legacy.
